meta.description: Global coverage contract for Achiote reference seeding across food forms, regions, name systems, mechanisms, and evidence levels

notes: Coverage axes are a planning contract, not authoritative cultural facts.
Use this matrix to prevent whole-category blind spots before adding sourced reference records.

foodForms.label: Food and drink forms
foodForms.description: Stable buckets for memory surfaces Achiote must support globally.

values.label: Beverage
values.description: Cold, hot, thick, fermented, grain, fruit, dairy, herb, or ritual drinks.

values.label: Soup and broth
values.description: Liquid-forward memories where broth, sip, steam, or spoon texture matters.

values.label: Stew and braise
values.description: Slow-cooked, sauce-rich, or gravy-centered preparations.

values.label: Sauce and condiment
values.description: Chutneys, salsas, dips, gravies, relishes, dressings, and table sauces.

values.label: Pickle and ferment
values.description: Sour, brined, fermented, preserved, or aged preparations.

values.label: Bread and flatbread
values.description: Leavened, unleavened, griddled, baked, steamed, or fermented breads.

values.label: Grain, rice, and noodle
values.description: Staples where starch type, cooking texture, or grain aroma anchors memory.

values.label: Dumpling and pocket
values.description: Filled wrappers, parcels, rolls, pies, buns, and hand-held enclosed foods.

values.label: Protein-centered
values.description: Meat, seafood, egg, legume, tofu, or fungi preparations where protein texture leads.

values.label: Vegetable and fungi
values.description: Leafy, root, gourd, mushroom, seaweed, and vegetable-forward memories.

values.label: Confectionery
values.description: Candy, brittle, fudge, nougat, halva, sugar glass, and small sweets.

values.label: Dessert
values.description: Puddings, custards, cakes, pastries, frozen sweets, fruit desserts, and celebratory sweets.

values.label: Snack and street food
values.description: Portable, fried, griddled, skewered, vendor, school, or market foods.

values.label: Ceremonial and holiday
values.description: Ritual, religious, seasonal, festival, wedding, mourning, or feast foods.

values.label: Breakfast
values.description: Morning foods and drinks with time-of-day or routine memory cues.

values.label: Sick-day comfort
values.description: Care foods, healing-adjacent comfort foods, and gentle foods without medical claims.

values.label: Pantry or single ingredient
values.description: Tiny nostalgia cues where one accessible ingredient or aroma does most of the work.

regionScopes.label: Region and culture scopes
regionScopes.description: Ways a memory can be geographically, culturally, or socially anchored without overclaiming identity.

values.label: Macro-region
values.description: Large research starting areas such as West Africa, South Asia, or the Caribbean.

values.label: Nation
values.description: Country-level cue used as a hypothesis, not a final family claim.

values.label: Subregion
values.description: State, province, island, valley, coastal, highland, or local area.

values.label: City
values.description: Urban, market, restaurant, neighborhood, or city-specific food memories.

values.label: Diaspora
values.description: Migration and adaptation contexts where ingredients or names shift.

values.label: Borderland
values.description: Foods shared or adapted across political, linguistic, or ecological borders.

values.label: Indigenous foodway
values.description: Indigenous, First Nations, Native, Aboriginal, or local ancestral foodway contexts.

values.label: Religious or ritual
values.description: Dietary, ceremonial, holiday, fasting, feast, or ritual contexts.

values.label: Migration corridor
values.description: Trade, colonial, labor, refugee, or family migration routes that shape memory.

nameSystems.label: Name systems
nameSystems.description: Ways users remember or misremember food names across languages and scripts.

values.label: Alias
values.description: Common alternate names for the same or related food family.

values.label: Transliteration
values.description: Latin-script approximations of non-Latin names.

values.label: Script form
values.description: Original-script names that may appear in family notes or packaging.

values.label: Phonetic memory
values.description: Soundalike fragments, partial syllables, and heard names.

values.label: Typo
values.description: Common weak-model or user spelling errors.

values.label: Family nickname
values.description: Private or informal names treated only as user-supplied clues.

values.label: Menu name
values.description: Restaurant, vendor, package, or translated menu names.

values.label: Colonial or postcolonial name
values.description: Names shaped by historical language contact and migration.

mechanisms.label: Sensory and food-science mechanisms
mechanisms.description: Reusable mechanisms that help small models produce a safe first cue without exact dish certainty.

values.label: Aroma
values.description: Volatile compounds, spice bloom, herbs, smoke, dairy aroma, or fruit aroma.

values.label: Browning
values.description: Maillard, caramelization, toasted grain, char, roasted spice, or fried edge notes.

values.label: Fermentation and acid
values.description: Sourness, brine, yogurt, vinegar, citrus, lactic fermentation, or tang.

values.label: Starch texture
values.description: Gelation, chew, grit, slipperiness, stickiness, porridge body, or noodle bounce.

values.label: Fat mouthfeel
values.description: Creaminess, oil bloom, ghee aroma, schmaltz, rendered fat, coconut richness, or butter.

values.label: Sugar crystal
values.description: Crackle, brittleness, syrup, fudge grain, caramel, jaggery, honey, or candy snap.

values.label: Smoke
values.description: Wood, charcoal, dried chile, smoked fish, cured meat, or hearth aromas.

values.label: Alkaline processing
values.description: Nixtamal, lye, kansui, ash, baking soda, or alkaline noodle and corn aromas.

values.label: Sauce balance
values.description: Salt, acid, sweetness, heat, umami, body, cling, and serving ratio.

values.label: Temperature
values.description: Cold, iced, room-temperature, hot, reheated, chilled, frozen, or steam cues.

values.label: Texture contrast
values.description: Crisp-soft, chewy-crunchy, creamy-gritty, broth-solid, or tender-charred contrast.

values.label: Serving ritual
values.description: Utensils, wrappers, bowls, cups, hands, family sequence, market ritual, or holiday service.

evidenceLevels.label: Evidence levels
evidenceLevels.description: Bounded levels for seed, research, and family-specific certainty.

values.label: Seed hypothesis
values.description: A research target, not a factual answer.

values.label: Researched record
values.description: A typed record backed by cited public references.

values.label: Family confirmed
values.description: User or family supplied clue, not globally authoritative.

values.label: Operator quality signal
values.description: Aggregate private signal from quality counters.
